description: Google Antigravity (agy acp) over the Agent Client Protocol. It is installed by Antigravity, usually at ~/.gemini/bin/agy, so put that folder on PATH or give the full path through yukta.ai.presets-dir. Log in once with agy; the node never logs in for you. It takes messages and an interrupt, asks before commands outside its workspace when approvals is ASK, and resumes a session by key.
